integration: Keep the shared shell, DICOM import, viewer, progress and dialogs that replace upstream's controllers and UI modules.
Keep model weights on the shared downloader with pinned hashes.

Keep Dicompare reporting lazy and stage its canonical controller, worker and SeedSeg schema from apps/dicompare/public into web/vendor/dicompare. Workspace startup and DICOM conversion must not wait for the remote report host.
Keep packages/seedseg as the shared scientific pipeline and the app worker as a browser adapter; port upstream scientific changes into the shared package.
Keep `@playwright/test` declared as exact devDependencies for the monorepo e2e suite; the dependency checker rejects tooling resolved through another workspace's or the root's node_modules.

Keep Cite owned by the shared shell. Move new upstream citations from web/index.html#citationsModal into registry/app-information.yml and test/app-information.test.mjs; do not restore the local Cite button, modal or handlers. The sync refreshes upstream-citations.json from its target commit and contract tests require every recorded DOI in the registry.
Keep the monorepo idle status: #statusText starts as "Drag and drop files" (design system); the window-wide drop comes from the shared components.

SeedSeg loads dicompare's controller, worker and schema from the locally staged web/vendor/dicompare copies. The rewrite points any remaining upstream reference to dicompare.neurodesk.org, which stopped serving in October 2026, at https://webapps.neurodesk.org/dicompare instead.
